risk_note: RV2 (settlement credit path + app.module wiring). FU-INVITE-REWARD-ON-CREDITED (prod-wiring gap 2; D10-805 ②, D10-810): settlement credit-order calls the invite-reward trigger through an optional injected port inside the R5 CREDITED transaction, after the CAS / history write and before publishing order.credited; app.module wires growth's createInviteRewardTrigger.onCredited; settlement does not import growth. R13 (CLAWED_BACK → CREDITED) does not trigger. BR-INV-24 ②'s B > 0 uses the booked base: app.module wraps the order-facts reader (bookedBaseOrderFacts) so a CREDITED order's base_fen is booked_base_fen for the immediate trigger, the expiry scan's late trigger and the payout scan alike (Codex money r1 S1); growth files untouched. The trigger only writes invite_rewards and runs under its own savepoint: a trigger error leaves the credit committed. No frozen test changed (the port is optional). Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).

reviews.note: Codex money r1 fail (S1: the expiry scan's late trigger still read the estimated base_fen) → rule tests attempt 3 (#18 #19) + implementation r2 → r2 pass, 0 findings (couli-runs/B2-04zzc/review-money-r1.saved.json, review-money-r2.json); reviews back on Codex per D10-823

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by a fresh independent Claude through claude-run.sh (attempts 1–3; attempt 1 relaunched once with a hand-assembled brief because brief.ts refused BR-INV-24 over 24KB); Codex spec-test r1 fail (3 S1: window by order time, estimate 0 / booked > 0, trigger leaves commission rows unchanged) → attempt 2 → r2 pass; attempt 3 added #18 #19 for money r1; red PASS 14 → 17 → 19; on the implementation the local container ran all 19 green (couli-runs/B2-04zzc/review-spec-r1.json, review-spec-r2.json)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
